summary.intent: Add differential tests that run the real @changesets/cli (pinned 3.x, optionally 2.x) in scratch npm workspaces and compare against callisto's Changesets compatibility (fixed-group migration via init and pre-mode v2/v3 state), wired into the verify-real-tools recipe and failing rather than skipping when tools are missing.
summary.outcome: Installed @changesets/cli 3.0.3 and 2.31.1 under target/verify-real, added Changesets scenarios to release_verify_real.rs, updated the justfile and docs/architecture/release.md, and passed fmt and clippy. A commit was being made (the first attempt failed on sandboxed gpg signing, so it was retried unsandboxed); push, PR, trail link and report to the lead were not yet done.

repo: PR #596 (config migration) was still open, so scenario (a) is based on main's current init behaviour, which must be noted in the PR body.

On main, `callisto init` only warns about a Changesets fixed group and does not translate it, while real Changesets bumps the group together. This is a real compatibility gap the differential test exposes.

verify-real tests live in crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_verify_real.rs and are #[ignore]d, run with `--ignored --test-threads=1`; the tools are installed locally under target/verify-real by the justfile verify-real-tools recipe.
Fixtures and harness helpers are in crates/callisto-cli/tests/common/ (release_harness.rs, local_registries.rs) and crates/callisto-fixtures/src/git.rs.
Changesets' @manypkg get-packages requires a proper workspace root (package.json with workspaces, possibly a lockfile or packageManager) or `changeset version` fails in the scratch workspace.
`changeset init` is interactive (GitHub integration prompt) in 3.x, so the scratch setup needs scripted input or writing .changeset/config.json directly.

code.finding: Init emits changesets config diagnostics (warning for fixed groups) rather than migrating them on main.

workflow: The sandbox blocks gpg keybox access, so signed commits need an unsandboxed retry; signing must stay on.
Use a $TMPDIR-based npm cache (--cache) to avoid sandbox write failures with npm.
Probe real-tool behaviour with throwaway scripts in /tmp before encoding assertions in tests.
Use CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 and avoid concurrent cargo builds in one worktree.

friction: The EnterWorktree and cd steps were repeated several times before the right worktree directory was active.
Interactive `changeset init` hung or needed several attempts with piped input before its flow was understood by reading init.mjs.
`changeset version` initially failed in the scratch workspace due to manypkg workspace detection, requiring debugging with a custom get-packages script.
The first signed commit failed because the sandbox blocked gpg's keybox.
open_items: Push the branch with `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` after merging the latest origin/main, confirm with git ls-remote, link trail #458, and open with `entire trail ci-pr`.
Note in the PR body that scenario (a) is based on main's behaviour because #596 had not merged, and that the fixed-group translation gap exists on main.
Report to the lead (close-gap-for-alpha) in under 5 lines: PR, sha, what was run.
Re-check whether #596 merges and update scenario (a) if so.
Confirm the CI workflow installs the pinned @changesets/cli via verify-real-tools (the install-registry-test-tools action was inspected but any change is not shown).
